setup_token.description: Base64 one-use HTTPS claim URL. Stored only in the private server credential store; generic receipts retain a SHA-256 fingerprint.

BankConnectionCreate.description: Submit a write-only setup token once. Durable client recovery must retain only its SHA256 and original nonsecret identity, then probe the receipt or cancel the original operation; never persist the raw token.

BankSecretDigest.description: SHA256 of the exact original setup_token string. Only valid with X-Actual-Receipt-Only:true or X-Actual-Cancel-If-Uncommitted:true. It cannot stage or replace credentials. Preserve every original nonsecret field, idempotency key and epoch with this digest.
